diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition lines 40–42 give the real inner-product quotient H_mu, feature subspace V_mu, and Pi_mu:H_mu -> V_mu. The arrows depict vectors in H_mu, not a Bellman map on equivalence classes; delta_w is the fixed class [T^pi v_w-v_w]_mu. Supplier lem-projected-bellman-error-is-well-defined proof 2.1 explicitly preserves that distinction.

Origin O=(0,0), projected tip P=(3,0), and residual tip D=(3,2) give arrows O->D labelled delta_w, O->P labelled Pi_mu delta_w, and P->D labelled delta_w-Pi_mu delta_w. Thus the head-to-tail relation is exactly delta_w = Pi_mu delta_w + (delta_w-Pi_mu delta_w).

Definition line 42 characterizes delta_w-Pi_mu delta_w as orthogonal to every vector in V_mu. The vertical remainder and horizontal projected vector with a right-angle marker depict precisely this relation; line 60 states the horizontal direction need not be the whole feature space.

Definition line 42 defines BE_mu(w) as the squared norm of the diagonal residual and PBE_mu(w) as that of the horizontal projection, matching line 60. No numerical lengths or dimension claim is asserted. The caption explicitly allows either component to vanish, so the generic drawn triangle does not impose nonzero residuals or positive feature rank.
The existing definition and supplier lemma proof 1.1–2.1 establish the quotient and unique projection independently. The new figure supplies no premise and replaces no proof.
